en.t: ...The more I thought about it, the happier I became.

units.source_text: 现在我目睹的围绕着我身边的世界，已经接近了没落与终结。

en.t: The world I now saw surrounding me had already drawn close to decline and extinction.

units.source_text: 落日的光辉曾照大地，载着承受夕照而辉煌灿烂的金阁的世界，

en.t: The world that had once been lit by the glow of the setting sun, bearing the Golden Pavilion as it shone brilliantly in the evening light,

units.source_text: 犹如从指缝漏掉的沙子实实在在地时时刻刻地掉落下去……

en.t: was truly, moment by moment, slipping away like sand leaking through one's fingers...
